proposed_value: For user-facing listing copy, flag terms such as "place name", "anchor", "useful moments", "where-question", "route phrase", "connect to", "this page", and "relationship rows" unless they are inside an editor-only note.
reason_for_change: Prevent content model language from leaking into traveler-facing UI.

proposed_value: For pageKind=place and placeKind=landmark, prefer task headings such as "Start here", "Getting there", "At the bridge", "Meeting or pickup", "Nearby needs". Avoid generic/redundant headings like "Use it with" and "When to use it" unless the page is a single phrase page.
reason_for_change: Make landmark pages feel intuitive to first-time travelers.

proposed_value: Every top-section body must pass: Would a tired traveler understand this while standing in the real situation? Flag abstract copy that describes the content system rather than the action.
reason_for_change: Create an editorial quality bar that blocks AI-sounding explanations.
